# has region

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasRegion`](gmeow-hasRegion.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasRegion>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/images`](../../slices/images.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an image to a region within it. Non-functional: an image may have many regions. Inverse of [`gmeow:regionOf`](gmeow-regionOf.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:MediaObject`](../classes/gmeow-MediaObject.md) -> [`gmeow:ImageRegion`](../classes/gmeow-ImageRegion.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasRegion`](gmeow-hasRegion.md) from [`gmeow:MediaObject`](../classes/gmeow-MediaObject.md) to [`gmeow:ImageRegion`](../classes/gmeow-ImageRegion.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Photo Metadata

- **Source:** [`slices/extensions/images/examples/photo-metadata.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/extensions/images/examples/photo-metadata.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-extensions-images-examples-photo-metadata)#example-slices-extensions-images-examples-photo-metadata

```turtle
# --- The image. A MediaObject is a Manifestation on the WEMI spine, so it embodies
#     an Expression realizing a Work (the same backing every published artifact has).
ex:photo a gmeow:MediaObject ;
    rdfs:label       "Team portrait, June 2026"@en ;
    gmeow:embodies   ex:photoExpression ;
    gmeow:hasExifTag ex:exifMake , ex:exifDate ;
    gmeow:hasRegion  ex:faceRegion .
```
